query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - develop
      - '4.x'
      - '5.x'
      - '5.0'
    paths-ignore:
      - '*.md'
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Cancel in progress workflows
# in the scenario where we already had a run going for that PR/branch/tag but then triggered a new run
concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.workflow }} ✨ ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.label || github.head_ref || github.ref }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 'lts/*'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install --ignore-scripts --include=dev

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

  test:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        node-version: [18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26]
        # Node.js release schedule: https://nodejs.org/en/about/releases/

    name: Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }} - ${{matrix.os}}

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

      - name: Configure npm loglevel
        run: |
          npm config set loglevel error
        shell: bash

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Output Node and NPM versions
        run: |
          echo "Node.js version: $(node -v)"
          echo "NPM version: $(npm -v)"

      - name: Run tests
        shell: bash
        run: npm run test-ci

      - name: Upload code coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: coverage-node-${{ matrix.node-version }}-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: ./coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 1

  coverage:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      checks: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install lcov
        shell: bash
        run: sudo apt-get -y install lcov

      - name: Collect coverage reports
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          path: ./coverage
          pattern: coverage-node-*

      - name: Merge coverage reports
        shell: bash
        run: find ./coverage -name lcov.info -exec printf '-a %q\n' {} \; | xargs lcov -o ./lcov.info

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: coverallsapp/github-action@8d6379e14d29928660c4ba802d8e85393440b329 # v2.3.8
        with:
          file: ./lcov.info

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
